raw:
The abstract describes a system that integrates a RAG framework with Bhashini and Dhenu models, grounded in agricultural knowledge bases. It proposes a RAG-based system, but it reports no experiments of its own; the yield figures come from pilot studies of similar interventions. It is not clearly a survey or position paper either. The rules say to include papers that propose a RAG method and not to exclude merely because baselines or metrics are missing, but whether experiments were run is unclear. Voice interaction is a modality, but the core RAG is text-based, so E9 does not apply. I am marking it MAYBE.

{"decision": "MAYBE", "code": null, "reason": "Proposes a RAG-based advisory system, but experiments are unclear; the cited pilot results are from similar interventions."}
